gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads like bent copper pipe, its big lowercase eyes and unfinished curves gliding along the line. And Woodgod, wide-channelled and commanding, gives it a vintage doorway to walk through.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans reads like a ruler-drawn line with a full-height lowercase. What stands out is the gap in temperament: Woodgod's commanding vintage swagger sits over a body line drawn with a constant wall.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi reads clean and sans-serif, its e opening clearly to the right and its lowercase running outsized. Woodgod brings its vintage, commanding display voice and wide-channelled bowls up top.
gen-dafont-zombie-holocaust-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, its generous curves and lighter horizontals best taken in modest helpings. Zombie Holocaust earns its keep big and short, where its dense, closely stitched capitals can crowd together.
gen-eater-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Dark and aggressive, with wide gaps: that's Eater. Beneath it BhuTuka Expanded One lays an authoritative, unmodulated line and curvy, unclamped letters that slow reading to a leisurely walk.
gen-eater-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, its open counters breathing into white space with a constant, paperclip-bent stroke. Eater's dark aggression rubs against that dignity, which is the fun.
gen-eater-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru has editorial, traditional manners, its terminals stopping far from the stem. Kiwi Maru's generous letterspacing and uniform joins would make extended reading go smoothly, with Eater supplying the dark edge.
gen-eater-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, each c a wide pitcher mouth. Eater does the dark, aggressive shouting; this one does the authoritative reading.
gen-eater-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Eater brings dark, aggressive color with wide gaps between its letters and thin strokes beside weightier stems. Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif, floats each character apart too, so the two share a spacious, pipe-cleaner looseness.
gen-fascinate-lora: Lora reads bookish, with a welcoming broad c and soft-pencil thinning, though this pairing isn't built for lengthy paragraphs. Fascinate does heavy pillars and fine wires; Lora does the quiet reading.
